notes:
What's new in 0.1.66:
• New: a proper Home screen for a brand-new library — real Beebo-owned sample artwork instead of a blank placeholder when your library is empty.
• New: a compact Home layout menu — choosing between Focus & Queue, Studio Canvas, Command Deck, and High-Impact Theater is now one menu instead of four buttons.
• Fixed the 'Connection route' screen sometimes showing the wrong answer after a fallback to Beebo Relay mid-stream.
• New storybook art: 15 storybooks now have hand-illustrated cartoon scenes instead of placeholder art.

Not code-signed yet — Windows SmartScreen will say 'Unknown publisher', this is expected.
